questions.standard_level: Probability & Statistics. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Probability & Statistics, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: An ad says a risk "increased 80%," from 1 in 10,000 to 1.8 in 10,000. Which statement is correct?
questions.prompt_markup: An ad says a risk "increased 80%," from 1 in 10,000 to 1.8 in 10,000. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The absolute risk rose by only 0.8 in 10,000.
Most people will now be affected by it.
The risk is now 80 out of every 100 people.
The risk went from 1% of people to 80%.

questions.correct_answer: The absolute risk rose by only 0.8 in 10,000.
questions.grading_note: Relative change sounds large; absolute change is tiny.

questions.prompt: A test catches 95% of people who have a rare disease. A report concludes that 95% of people who test positive have it. What is the error?
